traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Confusing 'Indica' (the original) with fragments preserved by later Greek writers like Arrian and Strabo.
Assuming the Arthashastra is purely a political manual; it contains deep insights into economic and social stratification.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Indigenous Texts

  • Arthashastra: Statecraft/Economy
  • Mudrarakshasa: Chanakya vs Nanda
  • Puranas: Dynastic lists

Foreign Accounts

  • Indica: Social setup
  • Clement/Strabo: Fragments
  • Buddhist Chronicles: Ashoka's life

Classification of Sources

  • Indigenous Literature:
    • Kautilya's Arthashastra: Discusses Saptanga theory.
    • Visakhadatta's Mudrarakshasa: Dramatic account of Chandragupta's rise.
  • Foreign Accounts:
    • Megasthenes' Indica: Describes 7-fold caste system.
    • Greek fragments: Emphasize Mauryan army and city administration.
